timothy2.4.p1.b1.text: I charge you in the presence of God and of Christ Jesus, who will judge the living and the dead …

timothy2.4.p1.b2.text: Preach the word; be prepared in season and out of season;

timothy2.4.p1.b3.text: reprove, rebuke, and encourage with every form of patient instruction.

timothy2.4.p2.b1.text: For the time will come when men will not tolerate sound doctrine, but with itching ears …

timothy2.4.p2.b2.text: So they will turn their ears away from the truth and turn aside to myths.

timothy2.4.p2.b3.text: But you, be sober in all things, endure hardship, …

timothy2.4.p2.b4.text: … do the work of an evangelist, fulfill your ministry.

timothy2.4.p3.b1.text: For I am already being poured out like a drink offering,

timothy2.4.p3.b2.text: and the time of my departure is at hand.

timothy2.4.p4.b1.text: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.

timothy2.4.p4.b2.text: From now on there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness, …

timothy2.4.p4.b3.text: and not only to me, but to all who crave His appearing.

timothy2.4.p5.b1.text: Make every effort to come to me quickly,

timothy2.4.p5.b2.text: because Demas, in his love of this world, has deserted me and gone to Thessalonica.

timothy2.4.p5.b3.text: Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus to Dalmatia.

timothy2.4.p6.b1.text: When you come, bring the cloak that I left with Carpus at Troas,

timothy2.4.p6.b2.text: and my scrolls, especially the parchments.

timothy2.4.p6.b3.text: Alexander the coppersmith did great harm to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.

timothy2.4.p6.b4.text: You too should beware of him, …
